tools.name: ggb_eval
tools.description: Execute GeoGebra commands in the graphing panel; the panel opens automatically. Use English GeoGebra syntax, ONE object per command string, in dependency order: functions "f(x)=sin(x)", "g(x)=x^2/4"; restricted "h(x)=If(0<=x<=2π, x^2)"; points "A=(1,2)"; intersections "A=Intersect(f,g,1)" (or Intersect(f,g) for all); shapes "c=Circle((0,0),3)", "s=Segment(A,B)", "p=Polygon(A,B,C)"; calculus "d=Derivative(f)", "i=Integral(f,0,1)"; style "SetColor(f,\"Blue\")". Use * for multiplication of names, ^ for powers, pi/π and sqrt(). Returns per-command success and the names of all objects — re-check failed commands and retry once.
